title: Bot answers from its own restaurant's menu only
when: Two restaurants with distinct products ('Karachi Special Tikka' vs 'Lahore Chargha'). Drive each restaurant's assistant directly (test hook like cloud/wa-host.js live map, with ask stubbed to capture the pos object it receives, or with real DeepSeek if keys exist) with 'what's on the menu?'
then: Karachi's assistant receives/answers with Karachi's menu only; Lahore's with Lahore's only; never server/pos.db content

title: readPos without pos throws in server mode
when: Call the pipeline ask() without pos inside the server process (TENANCY=1)
then: Throws a clear error; does not open server/pos.db (mtime unchanged)

title: WhatsApp routes resolve per restaurant
when: GET /api/whatsapp/status in a restaurant with no WhatsApp; POST /api/whatsapp/connect with WHATSAPP unset in a test DATA_DIR (do NOT scan the QR)
then: Status {state:'off'} before connect; after connect a QR/connecting state only for that restaurant; the other restaurant still 'off'; no duplicate route registration (start/stop twice, no warnings)

title: Suspend stops the bot, activate restarts it
when: Connect (QR state) in a restaurant, suspend via vendor API, then activate
then: Instance stopped on suspend (status off/disconnected), credentials folder kept; on activate a bot that was running AND has saved creds restarts; a never-linked bot (QR stage only) stays off until the owner presses Connect

title: Rider link works for that rider and restaurant only
when: Create rider in karachi, get link /r/karachi-grill/<token>; open in browser; dispatch a delivery order to that rider; accept and mark delivered from the rider page; try the token with lahore-bbq slug and against another rider's order
then: Rider page shows the order and works (status out → delivered, money via deliverOrder); lahore slug → error page; other rider's order refused

title: Tracking page shows only safe fields
when: Open /track/karachi-grill/<track_token> for an 'out' order; inspect the API response
then: Shows status and rider name/position; response has no customer phone, address, other orders; wrong slug or token → not found

title: Old modules are gone and nothing references them
when: ls and grep for licence, cloud-sync, rider-sync, setup, restore, Activate in server/ and client/src
then: Files deleted; no require/import of them; server boots; client builds; lint passes

title: Demo works with tenancy
when: node demo/seed.js then npm run demo (own scratch DATA_DIR)
then: Demo site at / and POS at /app with role picker, demo data visible; no crash

title: Slices A–C still pass
when: Re-run the slice A api suite, B-02/B-04, C-05/C-07/C-09
